name: Project INKFISH
axiom: SteamOS IS on the Space Deck. IS our Valve. Make gaming fun again.
what: biomeOS as gaming OS. Space Deck IS the Steam Deck. Gaia runs games. Sovereign gaming.

people.gabe_newell: Gabe Newell — Valve. Steam. SteamOS. Steam Deck. Half-Life. Portal. The man who made PC gaming sovereign.
people.ryan_cohen: Ryan Cohen — GameStop. The squeeze. Diamond hands. Making retail gaming matter again.
people.valve: Valve Corporation — Steam, SteamOS, Proton, Steam Deck. Open gaming platform.
people.gamestop: GameStop — retail gaming, community, diamond hands, power to the players

connection.biomeOS_is_steamOS: biomeOS orchestrates like SteamOS orchestrates. Process supervision. Deploy graphs. Sovereign on hardware.
connection.space_deck_is_steam_deck: The Space Deck at :3141/deck IS the control surface. Like Steam Deck is the handheld control surface.
connection.valve_is_the_valve: Valve controls flow. Our Golgi is the valve — thin, packages, ships.
connection.inkfish: Cuttlefish + ink. Camouflage + expression. Changes color to communicate. Prints patterns. Like petalTongue renders.

gaming.fun_again: Gaming should be fun. Not microtransactions. Not loot boxes. Sovereign. Local. Your hardware. Your games.
gaming.proton: Valve's Proton runs Windows games on Linux/SteamOS. biomeOS runs everything on Gaia.
gaming.deck_verified: Space Deck verified = runs on the organism
